# Cocode Guard for Android

> A free-software (GPL-3.0) Android app that blocks dangerous sites and ads for every app on the
> phone, on any network, by filtering DNS lookups on the phone itself. It uses Android's VpnService
> only as a local tunnel that ends inside the app: no VPN server, no account, no analytics. Kotlin
> and Jetpack Compose, no Google libraries, built for TalkBack and large text. The phone companion
> of the Cocode Guard home-network box.

Built by Babak Bandpey (Cocode, https://cocode.dk).

Design rules that explain most of the code:

- **Only DNS enters the tunnel.** The tunnel's single route is a fake DNS address; all other
  traffic bypasses the app.
- **Stop means stop, said plainly.** If protection stops, a notification says so; the app never
  fails silently.
- **Blind-friendly is a requirement, not a polish step.** Spoken labels, live-region status,
  200% font size, WCAG AA contrast enforced by a unit test.
